notes.decision: Translated 'purpose of heart of the Greatness' per accumulated vocabulary. The First Man's mission was the divine commission from the Father.

Both Greek loanwords for 'time' appear: ⲭⲣⲟⲛⲟⲥ (chronological span) in line 5, ⲕⲁⲓⲣⲟⲥ (appointed moment) in lines 7, 13, 28-29. Preserved in transliteration where ⲭⲣⲟⲛⲟⲥ but rendered 'time' for ⲕⲁⲓⲣⲟⲥ.

Translated 'powers' as Lycopolitan reflex of ⲛϭⲟⲙ/ⲛϭⲁⲙ 'powers.' The ⲁ- prefix may reflect a vocalic shift or dialectal article. Context (separation of beautiful/light from 'all the X') strongly suggests dark archonic powers.

Translated 'he drew' from ϫⲱⲗⲕ̄ 'draw, set in array.' The cosmological pairing with ⲥⲱⲍⲣⲉ 'drove down' in line 18 suggests opposite vertical motions: drew up (light) / drove down (Error). Lyc. ⲭ for ϫ regular.

Translated 'the Error' (capitalized) as nominalization of ⲥⲱⲣⲙ̄ 'go astray, err' = ⲡⲗⲁⲛⲏ. Preserves Manichaean cosmic principle. The pairing 'drove Error to the Deep' / 'drew light to the Height' is the cosmic separation.

Translated 'the abortions fell downward' — ⲍⲟⲩⲍⲉ likely Lyc. reflex of ϩⲟⲩⲣⲉ/ϩⲟⲟⲩⲗⲉ 'miscarriage, abortion.' This is the standard Manichaean myth: the Third Ambassador's revelation caused the dark archons to expel their abortions, which fell to earth. Adam and Eve are then fashioned in flesh from these. Confidence high based on cosmological context.
Visible word at end of partial line 15. ⲥⲱⲣ = 'spread, scatter' (Sah. ⲥⲱⲣ). Translated 'spread' but full clause lost in lacuna.

Identified as ἀνδριάς 'the Statue' = Manichaean Last Statue (eschatological figure of redeemed light at the end of times). Editor's reading [ⲡⲁⲛⲁ̄]ⲣⲉⲓⲁⲥ reflects damaged ⲇ̄. The eschatological context ('time when X will come upward at the end') confirms this technical term.
